rows.owner_note: AIAA S-120A and SAWE RP 7 tables are paywalled and were not opened. The allowances are NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1 (NTRS 20120013284), adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 Table 1. My map from maturity to its TRL rows is estimated to TRL 0-2, calculated to TRL 3-5 and measured to TRL 8. Different tables shift the numbers; no plausible table brings the concept-stage allowance below the 2.8-9.9% that the bills tolerate.
rows.checker_disposition: Open applicability; source table transcription verified. Historical NASA guidance is not direct access to S-120A, a present project requirement, or installed-hull maturity evidence.

rows.owner_note: Faces, core, SiC, PBO and pads are classed calculated, because they are sized by analysis and none are built. Joints, films, seams, sleeves, nodes and primer are classed estimated (rules and catalog areal masses). The finish carries its own +10%; P3's joint allowance above the actual sleeves is its own margin. The 100 kg systems allowance, the vacuum-service charge, gas, contamination, retained water, weather headroom and the sag lift debit get none.
rows.checker_disposition: All28 item mappings reproduced; calculated/measured labels alone do not prove the claimed maturity row. Zero hardware-allocation growth preserves the brief convention but needs a reserve breakdown.

rows.owner_note: P2 bills at R20 and R30 are 040's (200 F fix) with 048's finish transferred: the 0.2 kg/m2 coating is replaced by 8.33 g/m2 plus 10 g/m2 primer plus absorbed water. Checked against 048 at R10-15 for the same subsets: differences of 0.2-9.2 kg. 048's cure-in-global and drying folds are not re-optimized at R20 or R30.
rows.checker_disposition: Transfer arithmetic verified for320 bills. Correct the reported range scope, retain unqualified R20/R30 thermal/cure transfer and radius-squared material-water extrapolation.

rows.owner_note: Geometry stays at the owners' optima. Re-optimizing with allowance-weighted masses could shift face/core splits slightly; it cannot close gaps of 579-6,410 kg.
rows.checker_disposition: Finite stored geometries verified. A global allowance-weighted optimum or proof that reoptimization cannot change a conclusion was not supplied; do not generalize beyond tested cases.

rows.owner_note: The optimism the allowance would need is a linear extrapolation of payload in the least set's usage, from its zero-payload point to its endpoint. P2 would need usage 1.78-2.13 and P3 4.6-30. Payload is not linear in usage; the point is that every value exceeds 1.
rows.checker_disposition: All eight two-point linear extrapolations reproduce. Values above one remain outside the stated optimism ranges and are not feasible design witnesses.

rows.owner_note: Environmental allowances and debits carry no allowance here but have their own uncertainties. At 1 mm retained water, every R10-15 case already fails (048 fold). Weather cases are separate rows.
rows.checker_disposition: Environmental and buoyancy uncertainties remain separate. Absorbed water is placed in the hardware subtotal by convention, not by verified thermal-hardware maturity.

rows.owner_note: The same GSFC source adds a system-level margin, typically 30% for Pre-Phase-A concepts, above the itemized allowance. Applying it would only deepen every deficit.
rows.checker_disposition: System margin remains omitted as declared. A nonnegative added charge can only deepen current concept-stage deficits; a full project budget is still absent.
